items.title: Caterpillar’s stock is sinking. Here’s what that means for the Dow.
items.content: Caterpillar’s data-center business is fine, but other areas disappointed. The stock was heading for its biggest loss in years.

items.title: Consumer spending flattens out after U.S. inflation surge
items.content: Consumer spending rose sharply in September, but it largely reflected households spending more on gas and transportation after an increase in energy costs.

items.title: Inflation surges, PCE shows. Fed pause on rate hikes unlikely to last with prices still rising.
items.content: Even though the Federal Reserve temporarily put its inflation fight on hold this week, the cost of living rose sharply again last month in a sign the central bank’s work is far from done.

items.title: The midterms are crucial to the future of Social Security – no matter how old you are
items.content: The program is expected to run out of money in the next six years, which is the same amount of time as a senator’s term.

items.title: 3 reasons home prices keep going up, even though fewer people are buying
items.content: Weaker demand typically drives prices down, but national readings of home prices indicate that they’re still growing. What explains the disconnect?

items.content: The U.S. economy ripped off its fastest rate of growth in a year, amped up by the boom in artificial intelligence and strong spending by wealthier Americans.
